div.head: II Cn 10
div.ab: ⁊ burhbota ⁊ bricbota ⁊ scipforðunga aginne man georne, ⁊ fyrdunga eac swa, á þænne þearf si for gemænelicre neode.
And burgbota ⁊ bricgbote ⁊ scipforðunga aginne man georne, ⁊ fyrdunga eac swa, á þonne þearf sy for gemenelicre neode.

Burhbotam et brigbotam (civitatum et pontium emendatio) et scipforðunga et fyrdunga (quę nauigii uel expeditionis sonant apparatum) sedulo procuremus, cum necesse fuerit ad commune regni nostri commodum.
⁊ burhbota ⁊ brycgbota ⁊ scipforðunga aginne man georne ⁊ fyrdunga eac swá, á ðonne ðearf sy for mænelicre neode.
And burhbota and bricbota and scipforðunga aginne man georne, and fyrdunga eac swa a þænne þearf si, for gemænelicre neode.

And henceforth the repair of fortifications and bridges, and the preparation of ships and the equipment of military forces likewise shall be diligently undertaken for the common need, whenever the occasion arises.
And improvements to fortifications and bridges are to be undertaken with care, and also the provisioning of the navy and army as the need arises, for the common good.
Und Festungsherstellungen und Brückenherrichtungen und Schiffsrüstungen unternehme man eifrig und ferner Landwehrstellungen, immer wenn es nöthig ist wegen gemeinsamen Bedarfs.
And let the repair of fortresses and the repair of bridges and the equipping of ships be eagerly undertaken, and military service likewise, whenever there is need for the common good.
